test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 16 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A factory produces 15, 20, 25, 10, and 30 units of a gadget over five days. What is the average production (in units) per day?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total units produced = 15 + 20 + 25 + 10 + 30 = 100 units.

Number of days = 5.

Average = Total Production ÷ Total Days = 100 ÷ 5 = 20 units.

**∴ The correct answer is 20 units.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Production values for 5 days: 15, 20, 25, 10, and 30 **units**.

**Formula Used:**

Average = (Sum of all observations) ÷ (Total number of observations)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a41afba47b110e1944445e82556b4af17d60db867adee69c7f8cdaa4366f7528.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Sum = 15 + 20 + 25 + 10 + 30

⇒ Sum = 100 **units**

⇒ Total Number of Days = 5

⇒ Average = 100 ÷ 5

⇒ Average = 20 **units**

**∴ The correct answer is 20 units.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average

When items have different weights, the average is calculated as Σ(wᵢxᵢ) ÷ Σwᵢ.

Deviation Method

The sum of the **deviations** of all observations from their arithmetic mean is always zero.

Average of AP

For a series in **Arithmetic Progression**, the average is simply (First Term + Last Term) ÷ 2.</p
